theater: 古巴聖地牙哥與馬尼拉灣

battle.name: 美西戰爭
battle.theater: 古巴聖地牙哥與馬尼拉灣
battle.brief: 一八九八年四月下旬美國對西班牙宣戰，五月至七月戰火同時燒到古巴聖地牙哥、馬尼拉灣同波多黎各。西班牙守軍以法製雷管步槍配後膛槍固守山頭，同美軍的春田步槍對射；聖地牙哥一役西班牙軍投降，古巴同菲律賓隨後易手。

kit.name: 雷管步槍
kit.history: 雷管取代火燧之後，底火在霧裡也打得響。射程變長，隊形就散了。

countries: 交戰的兩方是美國與西班牙兩個國家體系。美國一方以總統威廉·麥金萊為最高權力核心，國會於一八九八年四月通過對西宣戰決議，陸軍部由部長拉塞爾·艾爾傑主持徵調，既有民兵制度被中止，改以志願入伍為主。遠征軍編為第五軍、第八軍與第六軍等部隊，由沙夫特、揚、邁爾斯等中將分頭率領，基層是第九師、第五師、第二十四師與第二十五師等師級單位，另有第七騎兵團與志願騎兵團。志願役制度帶來大量沒有受過射擊訓練的人，軍械不足時甚至要自備步槍。海軍分亞細亞分艦隊與北大西洋分艦隊兩支，分別由杜威與塞彭斯指揮。西班牙一方以馬德里為中樞，陸軍部與海軍部分掌兵權，古巴與菲律賓各有自己的常備守備軍與地方民兵；西班牙本土尚有預備役與民兵團，但能派往海外的兵力有限，彈藥與財政都難以支撐長期防守殖民地。古巴起義軍與菲律賓革命軍站在西班牙的對面，但它們是民族解放武裝而非國家軍隊，編制與裝備極不統一，多數槍械來自民間與舊式前膛槍。
countriesEn: The two sides were the two national systems of the United States and Spain. On the American side President William McKinley was the highest centre of power; Congress passed the joint resolution declaring war in April 1898, the War Department under Secretary Russell A. Alger handled the mobilisation, and the existing militia system was suspended in favour of volunteer enlistment. The expeditionary force was organised into the Fifth, Eighth and Sixth Corps, led by such majors-general as Shafter, Young and Miles, and built out of divisions such as the Ninth, Fifth, Twenty-fourth and Twenty-fifth, together with the 7th Cavalry and the volunteer cavalry regiments. The volunteer system brought in large numbers of men with no marksmanship training, and where arms were short the recruits sometimes had to bring their own rifles. The navy was divided into the Asiatic Squadron and the North Atlantic Squadron, under Dewey and Sampson respectively. On the Spanish side Madrid was the centre, with the War and Navy Ministries holding the military power, while Cuba and the Philippines each maintained their own garrisons and local militias; reserves and militia regiments existed in metropolitan Spain as well, but the forces that could be sent overseas were limited, and neither treasury nor ammunition stores could support a long defence of the colonies. Against Spain stood the Cuban insurgents and the Philippine revolutionaries, but they were national liberation armed bodies rather than state armies: their organisation and equipment were uneven, and most of their weapons were obsolete muzzle-loaders obtained privately.
people: 關鍵人物集中在少數幾個位置上。麥金萊在白宮主持決策，國務卿約翰·海伊早已主張干預古巴，海軍部長威廉·麥卡德利·約翰遜則力主用實力解決古巴航運與僑民問題。陸軍參謀長邁爾斯中將是野戰的核心，他組織登陸與展開，並力主把主力壓向聖地牙哥；第五軍中將沙夫特負責古巴主攻，第八軍中將揚統率波多黎各方向的部隊。海軍方面，亞細亞分艦隊司令杜威以巡洋艦突入馬尼拉灣，北大西洋分艦隊司令塞彭斯負責封鎖聖地牙哥港。陸戰第一線還有第七騎兵團上校庫寧漢、率領志願騎兵團的西奧多·羅斯福中校，以及率軍攻入聖地牙哥城的威廉·加文中校；古巴方面是起義軍領袖多明哥·杜爾塞。西班牙方面，聖地牙哥守軍主將巴西利奧·奧古斯丁少將、埃爾卡內伊守將何塞·古蒂耶雷斯少將、菲律賓總督費爾南多·普里莫·德·里維拉、馬尼拉海軍統帥帕斯夸爾·塞韋拉與蒙特霍霍相繼指揮；埃米利奧·阿吉納爾多在菲律賓革命軍中作戰，日後於一八九九年的菲律賓戰爭中成為美國的對手。
peopleEn: The decisive figures were concentrated in a handful of positions. McKinley directed policy from the White House, with Secretary of State John Hay long arguing for intervention in Cuba, and Secretary of the Navy William McAdoo pushing the use of force to settle the shipping and the lives of American residents in Cuba. On the army side Lieutenant-General Miles was the core of the field effort, organising the landings and the drive inland and pressing for the main effort to be turned on Santiago de Cuba; Major-General Shafter commanded the attack in Cuba and Major-General Young the force sent towards Puerto Rico. At sea, Commodore Dewey took his cruisers into Manila Bay while Commodore Sampson blockaded the harbour of Santiago. Closer to the fighting were Lieutenant-Colonel Cushing of the 7th Cavalry, Lieutenant-Colonel Theodore Roosevelt who led the volunteer cavalry, and Lieutenant-Colonel William Garvin who led the American troops into the city of Santiago; on the Cuban side Domingo Dulce headed the insurgents. For Spain came Brigadier-General Basilio Agustin, commander at Santiago, Major-General Jose Gutierrez at El Caney, Governor-General Fernando Primo de Rivera in the Philippines, Admiral Pascual Cervera and Admiral Patricio Montojo with the fleet; Aguinaldo fought with the Philippine revolutionaries and a year later became the American opponent in the Philippine war.
kits: 卡面這件雷管步槍是全場的技術底色。雷管發火在一八四〇年代由法國率先推上軍用，底火在雨霧夜戰中仍然可靠，射程因此從一百多公尺推到三百公尺以上，這在古巴山地的濃霧夜戰裡屢次決定勝負。西班牙軍隊裝備龐雜，早期主力是法製一八六六年獵兵步槍與一八七〇年格拉步槍等雷管前膛槍，另有大量美國雷明登轉輪式後膛槍與毛瑟一八七九年式，栓動與轉輪混用，後膛結構讓西班牙軍在裝填速度與容彈量上吃虧。美國遠征軍的標準步槍是春田一八七二年與一八八八年栓動後膛槍，並大量配發四五／七〇春田步槍與一八八五年李—恩菲爾德步槍，部分部隊裝備一八九二年式克拉格步槍。炮兵方面美國有三吋野戰炮、四點二吋迫擊炮與加特林機槍，西班牙配備七公分與十二公分野戰炮、十五公分榴彈炮與三十公分級攻城重炮，山地作戰中射程與射速都不及美軍；美軍裝甲巡洋艦配八吋主炮，西班牙裝甲巡洋艦配九點四吋級主炮。運輸靠軍馬、騾車與蒸汽火車，海上靠二十餘艘運兵船與煤油船，馬尼拉灣一役後西班牙殘餘商船多被燒毀或擄走。
kitsEn: The percussion rifle on the card is the technical backdrop of the whole campaign. The percussion cap was first put into military service by France in the 1840s: the primer fired reliably in rain, fog and night action, and effective range was pushed from a little over a hundred metres to more than three hundred, a matter that repeatedly decided fights in the foggy hills of Cuba. The Spanish army's equipment was a museum of systems: the main body was still French percussion muzzleloaders such as the 1866 Chassepot and the 1870 Gras rifle, alongside large numbers of American Remington rolling-block rifles and Mauser Model 1879, with bolt and toggle action mixed together, and the breech-loading layout cost the Spanish soldier in reload speed and in ammunition carried. The standard rifle of the American expedition was the bolt-action Springfield Model 1872 and Model 1888 trapdoor, with large issues of the .45-70 Springfield and the 1885 Lee-Enfield, and some units carrying the 1892 Krag. On the artillery side the Americans brought the 3-inch field gun, the 4.2-inch mortar and the Gatling gun, while Spain had 7cm and 12cm field pieces, 15cm howitzers and 30cm-class siege guns; in the mountains the Spanish pieces could neither outrange nor outpace the American ones. The American armoured cruisers carried 8-inch guns and the Spanish armoured cruisers 9.4-inch-class pieces. Transport rested on horses, mules, wagons and the steam railway, and at sea on more than twenty transports and colliers; after the fight in Manila Bay most surviving Spanish merchant vessels were burned or taken.
tactics: 一八九八年的戰術爭論正好套在這件兵器上。西班牙守軍多據山頭與土木工事，從埃爾卡內伊到聖胡安山拉成一條縱深防線，用交叉火力封鎖通往聖地牙哥的道路；美軍則沿古巴東岸由海路與陸路平行推進，靠運兵船在關鍵地點登陸，再以連續縱隊行軍。步兵排的射擊紀律仍按一八九〇年代手冊執行：散兵線展開，軍官定射界、士官定目標，射擊以連續射擊為主，實際有效射程落在四百公尺上下，而不是紙面上的一千公尺。粗糙騎兵團在聖胡安山的進攻是典型案例：他們放棄整齊的縱隊衝鋒，改用散兵線逐段攀爬，馬匹留在山下，用人數與地形換取進展。炮兵在攻山時難以展開，常被迫分批投入，機槍則在側翼壓制暴露的射擊線。海軍陸戰隊另有一套攻堅辦法，用迫擊炮與輕型機槍壓住對面火位，再以工兵清障。西屬古巴的起義游擊隊配合騷擾西班牙的交通線，菲律賓方向則演變成遠征軍與革命軍的持久消耗戰。
tacticsEn: The tactical argument of 1898 fitted this weapon exactly. The Spanish usually held the hills and their earthworks, drawing a line in depth from El Caney to San Juan Hill and interlocking their fire across the roads into Santiago de Cuba; the Americans advanced in parallel along the eastern shore of Cuba, both by sea and by land, landing the transports at the decisive points and then moving inland in successive columns. Rifle-company fire discipline still followed the manuals of the 1890s: the line was extended, officers took the range and sergeants the target, firing was continuous rather than by simultaneous volley, and the real effective range lay near four hundred metres rather than the thousand metres claimed on paper. The charge of the volunteer cavalry up San Juan Hill is the classic case: they abandoned the ordered column, climbed in extended order, left the horses below and bought ground with numbers and terrain. Artillery could rarely deploy in the attack and was fed in in dribs; machine guns were worked on the flanks against the exposed firing line. The marines had their own method of storming a position, using mortars and light machine guns to silence the opposing fire and engineers to clear the wire. Cuban insurgents harassed Spanish communications, and in the Philippines the campaign degenerated into a long attritional struggle between the expedition and the revolutionaries.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。西班牙在古巴的總兵力約五萬人，聖地牙哥一帶約一萬二千人，真正守在防線上的不足八百人；美國遠征古巴的部隊到六月底約五萬人，投入聖地牙哥方向攻擊的約一萬五千人。埃爾卡內伊一戰，西班牙守軍約五百二十人，美軍約三千五百人，攻方陣亡約二百人、負傷約六百人。聖胡安山一戰，西班牙守軍不到八百人，軍方記載陣亡二百三十四人，美軍陣亡約二百一十至二百五十人、負傷逾一千二百人。馬尼拉灣海戰，西班牙分艦隊十艘，其中三艘裝甲巡洋艦、三艘戰列艦，擊沉七艘、焚燒擄走兩艘，艦上官兵死亡約三千二百人、被俘七千餘人；美軍五艘主力巡洋艦與護衛艦只付出極輕微代價。整場戰爭美國方面官方記載陣亡二千四百四十六人、受傷一萬一千餘人，俘獲西班牙軍人約一萬六千人；波多黎各方向雙方傷亡有限，佔領本身未遇頑強抵抗。巴黎和約裡美國為菲律賓支付二千萬美元。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. Spain had about 50,000 men in Cuba and some 12,000 in the Santiago area, but fewer than eight hundred actually held the defensive line; by the end of June the American forces in Cuba numbered about 50,000, of whom roughly 15,000 were committed to the attack on Santiago. At El Caney, about 520 Spanish troops faced some 3,500 Americans, the attackers losing about two hundred dead and six hundred wounded. On San Juan Hill the Spanish force numbered under eight hundred; the Spanish official count of the dead was 234, while the Americans lost about 210 to 250 dead and more than 1,200 wounded. In the battle of Manila Bay the Spanish squadron counted ten ships, including three armoured cruisers and three battleships; seven were sunk and two burned or taken, with about 3,200 dead and more than 7,000 prisoners taken, while the five American cruisers and gunboats paid only a very small price. For the war as a whole the American official record gives 2,446 dead and more than 11,000 wounded, with about 16,000 Spanish soldiers captured; in Puerto Rico casualties on both sides were limited, since the occupation met no determined resistance. In the Treaty of Paris the United States paid twenty million dollars for the Philippines.
cause: 戰爭的直接導火線是緬因號事件。一八九八年二月十五日，停在哈瓦那港的美國戰艦緬因號在夜裡爆炸沉沒，艦上兩百六十餘人罹難，肇因至今未有定論。麥金萊最初要求西班牙協查，被婉拒之後，國會內的強硬派與全國報紙的渲染把政府一步步推向動武。深層原因則是古巴自一八九五年起持續的起義戰爭、委內瑞拉危機餘波、美國新興工業對西班牙市場與海外投資的競爭，以及一份份誇大的報導（當時被稱為黃色新聞）把古巴的消息傳遍全國，令總統在議會與輿論的夾擊下難以退讓。西班牙政府拒絕交出古巴的軍事據點，也拒絕讓美國官員登船查核，選擇硬頂，這一決定把一次外交危機推成全面戰爭。
causeEn: The immediate trigger was the loss of the Maine. On the night of 15 February 1898 the American battleship Maine exploded and sank in Havana harbour, killing more than two hundred and sixty of her men, and the cause has never been conclusively established. McKinley at first asked Spain to allow an investigation; when the request was refused, the hardliners in Congress and the agitation of the press pushed the government step by step towards war. Behind them lay the Cuban revolt that had run since 1895, the after-effects of the Venezuela crisis, American industry competing for Spanish markets and Spanish investment abroad, and a series of inflated reports, then known as yellow journalism, that carried the Cuban story across the country and left the President with no room to retreat in the face of Congress and the public. The Spanish government refused to surrender its military positions in Cuba and refused to let American officers board the ship to examine her, and chose to hold firm; that decision turned a diplomatic crisis into a general war.
impact: 一八九八年之後，世界次序被改寫。美國從此被視為世界強權，國會隨即批准建造一批裝甲巡洋艦與主力艦的撥款，德國與日本隨之加快海軍擴張；美國把古巴變成沒有主權的保護國，把菲律賓、波多黎各與關島納入版圖，同年更取得巴拿馬運河的開鑿權，一九一四年通航後，海軍的戰略重心從加勒比移向巴拿馬。菲律賓的接管隨即引發一八九九年至一九〇二年的美菲戰爭，革命軍與美軍在呂宋的鄉村與叢林周旋六年，長期佔住美國的注意力，也逼美軍重新檢討應對游擊作戰的方法。西班牙則被視為歐洲的反面教材，軍隊的裝備與訓練體系全面整頓，君主制的威信受損，一九〇二年國王退位。戰爭的教訓同時進入各國軍事學院：遠射程步槍要求隊形更分散、射擊紀律更嚴格，也要求在火力與移動之間取得新的平衡。
impactEn: After 1898 the world order was rewritten. The United States was henceforth treated as a world power, Congress voted money at once for a new class of armoured cruisers and battleships, and Germany and Japan quickened their own naval expansion. Cuba became a protectorate without sovereignty, the Philippines, Puerto Rico and Guam were taken into the American orbit, and in the same year the United States secured the right to build a canal across Panama; when it opened in 1914 the strategic centre of the fleet moved from the Caribbean to the Isthmus. The annexation of the Philippines brought on the Philippine-American war of 1899 to 1902, in which the revolutionaries and the American army moved through the villages and woods of Luzon for six years, tying down American attention and forcing a rethinking of how to answer guerrilla war. Spain was treated in Europe as a warning example, its army's equipment and training overhauled, the prestige of the monarchy damaged and the king driven from the throne in 1902. The lessons of the war entered the staff colleges of many countries at the same time: a rifle with long reach demanded looser formations, stricter fire discipline and a new balance between the weight of fire and the freedom of movement.
result: 戰果在三個月內分三路揭曉。五月一日，巡洋艦隊在馬尼拉灣擊毀西班牙分艦隊，港內守軍失去海上屏障；六月二十四日聖地牙哥港外的海戰與岸上進攻同時收束，七月一日美軍在埃爾卡內伊與聖胡安山取得決定性勝利，七月十六日守軍同意停火、十七日交出聖地牙哥城，約一萬人至一萬二千人被俘，古巴戰役就此結束。八月，波多黎各方向的部隊登陸，島上主要城鎮依次易手，但西班牙游擊隊仍在大陸游鬥。十一月，巴黎和談開始；十二月十日簽訂的和約規定西班牙放棄對古巴的一切主權，割讓波多黎各、關島與菲律賓，後者由美國以二千萬美元支付代價；美國同時承接維持古巴秩序的義務，實際上取得干預權，三年後更以普拉特修正案把它寫成明文條款。戰爭以西班牙的全面失敗告終，但美國付出的代價、馬尼拉與古巴的善後，以及隨之而來的菲律賓抵抗，讓這場短暫的勝利變成一場長期的負擔。
resultEn: The results were settled on three fronts within three months. On 1 May the cruiser squadron destroyed the Spanish fleet in Manila Bay and the garrison in the harbour lost its cover from the sea; on 24 June the naval fight outside Santiago and the land attack on the hills closed together, and on 1 July the Americans took El Caney and San Juan Hill, the garrison agreeing to a ceasefire on 16 July and handing over the city of Santiago on the 17th with about ten to twelve thousand men taken prisoner, which ended the Cuban campaign. In August the troops landed in Puerto Rico and the principal towns on the island changed hands one after another, though Spanish irregulars kept fighting on the mainland. In November the peace conference opened in Paris, and on 10 December the treaty signed there renounced all Spanish sovereignty over Cuba and ceded Puerto Rico, Guam and the Philippines, the last to the United States for a payment of twenty million dollars. The United States also took on the obligation of keeping order in Cuba, which was in practice the right to intervene, written down three years later in the Platt Amendment. The war ended in complete Spanish defeat, but the price America paid, the aftermath in Manila and Cuba, and the resistance that followed in the Philippines turned a brief victory into a long burden.
